name: drawing-cursor
title: Drawing Cursor
description: The cursor leaves a smooth ink line on a click-through canvas that thins when you move fast and fades as it dries.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the area. The ink is drawn above it and never blocks clicks.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS color. Defaults to the primary token.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Widest the line gets, in pixels.

props.name: decay
props.description: Milliseconds a stretch of ink takes to fade out.

props.name: taper
props.description: Thin the line where the cursor moves fast.

props.name: clearOnLeave
props.description: Wipe the ink when the cursor leaves the area.
